title: CodeTS: Verifiable Text-to-Time Series Generation via Executable Code
abstract: arXiv:2609.15393v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-Time Series Generation (Text-to-TS) provides a promising paradigm for synthesizing time series from natural language, enabling scenario-specific generation when real observations are scarce or costly to acquire. However, existing methods typically lack an explicit mechanism for deriving generation logic from textual descriptions to guide time series synthesis. In this paper, we propose CodeTS, a verifiable framework that uses code as an intermediate generation interface, reformulating Text-to-TS generation as a Text-to-Code-to-TS process. CodeTS first maps textual temporal descriptions into an explicit code space, where executable code specifies how textual requirements shape target temporal patterns, and then obtains the time series through code execution. translated_title: CodeTS：通过可执行代码实现可验证的文本到时间序列生成
translated_abstract: 文本到时间序列生成为从自然语言合成时间序列提供了一种有前景的范式，能够在真实观测数据稀缺或获取成本高昂的情况下实现特定场景的生成。然而，现有方法通常缺乏一种显式机制来从文本描述中推导出生成逻辑，以指导时间序列的合成。在本文中，我们提出了CodeTS，一个以代码作为中间生成接口的可验证框架，将文本到时间序列生成重新表述为“文本到代码再到时间序列”的过程。CodeTS首先将文本中的时间描述映射到显式的代码空间，其中可执行代码明确规定了文本需求如何塑造目标时间模式，然后通过执行代码获得时间序列。为了在没有真实代码标注的情况下可靠地学习这一代码生成过程，CodeTS从结构化时间属性中构建对齐的文本-代码-时间序列三元组用于监督
tldr: 提出CodeTS框架，将文本到时间序列生成重新表述为“文本到代码再到时间序列”的过程，以可执行代码作为中间接口实现可验证的时序数据生成，并通过结构化时间属性构建的三元组进行监督学习。
en_tdlr: CodeTS reformulates Text-to-Time Series generation as a Text-to-Code-to-TS process, using executable code as a verifiable intermediate interface, with supervision from aligned Text-Code-TS triplets constructed from structured temporal attributes.
